name: Bogner Ecstasy 101B - clean + OD channels, FX loop, PI, 4 x EL34
description: Bogner Ecstasy 101B, catalogue unit 162000: the whole amplifier. Input 68k / 1M into one grid line shared by the clean channel's first stage and the OD channel's V1A. Ch1 (clean, S4): 100k / 1k5 || 22u stage -> Fender-type stack straight off the plate (220p treble cap, 100k slope, .1 / .047, TREBLE 250k, BASS 250k rheostat, MID 25k rheostat) -> 1M with PRE-EQ 100p / 220p -> 100k / 1k5 || 22u stage -> .022 -> 3M3 || 12p into 220k (clean-boost puts 1M + 1n across it) -> 100k / 1k5 || 22u stage -> .01 -> 50k level -> 220k -> 390k + .047 shelf. Ch2 / Ch3 (OD, S2 values, S1 relays): V1A -> 4n7 -> CH2 / CH3 GAIN pots (relay-selected wiper; each channel's own 3-way PRE EQ puts 470p / none / 4n7 from the bus to the wiper; the Plexi assignment sends the wiper straight to V4A through 499k || 470p) -> 470k || 470p / R6 boost shunt -> V2A (Structure S1) -> 2n2 / 500k pads -> V3A (10k cathode) -> .022 -> 500k || 470p -> V4A DC-coupled into the V5 cathode follower -> 470p / 22n / 22n / 33k / 250k / 1M / 25k stack -> VOLUME (inserted). The channel relays select the active output onto the loop input; each sheet's own mute contact grounds the idle channel. FX loop on rail D (send follower, normalled return stage) -> GLOBAL MASTER (inserted) -> PI on rail C (22n, 82k / 100k, 47p plate to plate, 470 / 10k tail, .1 to the second grid, 4k75, .1 couplings) -> 4 x EL34 in two folded pairs (4k7 stoppers, 220k leaks to bias rail A, 470 screen resistors through Sound Style: screens on the screen supply or on their own plates, 250 ohm 50 W cathode resistors behind the half-power relays) -> OT 1.7k : 4 / 16 -> 4x12. Feedback: OT 4 ohm -- 100k -- n2f -- 1M || 470p -- FB -- 22p -- tail node. Supply (S7 as drawn): bridge -> 110u -> choke -> 110u + 440k bleed (screens) -> 15k -> C (50u) -> 10k -> D (50u) and 10k -> E (50u) -> 5k -> F (50u) -> 5k -> G (50u); bias winding -> 22k -> rail A (150u) -> 51k + 25k adjust. NOT IN THIS NETLIST (notes S26-S28): the Excursion switch, its 220k, its .1 and its two 25k trims (their far ends are six pads whose wiring no sheet draws); S1's third stage-skip changeover SK2 (V3A skip; a manual actuator is drawn but no panel function is documented), wired in its drawn position; the FX loop's 'FROM FX 1' feed and send-mute pole; the 'AB/A' second position; one-valve-per-pair half power.

io.note: outputVoltsPerFS = 1.5 x the largest dimed speaker peak of the three channels: Ch2 / Ch3 +83.68 / -45.49 V (Ch1 +80.8 / -77.4 V) with gain = low = mid = treble = volume = master = 1, a 1 kHz 0.05 V peak input, settled start (notes S29). 'spk' is the 16 ohm tap into the library's 4x12 equivalent.

controls.label: Channel
controls.note: Catalogue 'Gain Mode' (3 steps; descriptor '3-Mode') drives the channel relays, as the Friedman BE-100 binds its Clean/BE/HBE. Ch1 = clean output to the loop/PI, OD gain bus grounded (S1 contact at (1457,887)-(1450,1044)); Ch2 / Ch3 = OD output to the loop/PI and the clean output muted (S4 contact at (3240,760)/(3220,850)), the CH2/CH3 relay picking that channel's GAIN pot wiper (S1 rings (1754,944) / (1750,1001), pole (1811,976)), and the relay's third pole (1582,1309) handing the 4n7 bus to that channel's PRE EQ terminal ('CH3' (1281,1570) / 'CH2' (1460,1560)). Ch2 and Ch3 differ by their own GAIN pot, their own 3-position PRE EQ (preEq2 / preEq3) and the Plexi assignment (plexi); bass/mid/treble, Structure and Boost are common, as the 101B manual says (notes S33).

controls.label: Gain
controls.note: Ganged: OD GAIN of the selected channel (RG2 / RG3, 500k-A each, both on the C2 4n7 bus) and the clean channel's 1M (RVC1, the pot between its tone stack and its second stage). Each knob acts on the selected channel, as on the Mesa 16000.

controls.label: Low
controls.note: Ganged: OD bass R23 1M-A (rheostat, wiper strapped to its top as S2 draws it) and clean bass RCB 250k (rheostat, S4 draws it with the variable-resistor arrow).

controls.label: Mid
controls.note: Ganged: OD mid R24 25k-B and clean mid RCM 25k (S4: wiper on the bass/.047 node, bottom to 0 V, top end unconnected = a rheostat).

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: Ganged: OD treble R22 250k-A and clean treble RCT 250k.

controls.label: Master
controls.note: GLOBAL MASTER, inserted at the FX loop's output (`RVG`, 500k-A, wiper 'mf' drives the PI). unverified: no sheet in the set draws a master. It has to sit after the loop because the loop's return stage is a full gain stage; see notes S21.4.

controls.label: Volume
controls.note: Channel VOLUME, ganged: the clean channel's drawn 50k level pot (RVC3, S4 crop (2855,630)-(2935,725)) and the OD channel's VOLUME (RVM 500k-A, inserted at the only dangling node of the OD sheet, R22's wiper stub). No catalogue parameter.

controls.label: Structure
controls.note: S1 'Structure' (S2: 'a front panel switch labeled "Structure". It is NOT footswitchable'). Closed: V2A cathode = R9 || R10 2.375k bypassed by C4 2.2u (more gain, fuller); open (drawn): R9 4.75k unbypassed. Was folded into gainMode before the channel relays were modelled.

controls.label: Boost
controls.note: RLY1 (S2: 'a footswitchable gain boost'; S1 labels the same contact 'Boost'). Normal (drawn) = R6 100k shunts the V2A grid pad (-16 dB); Boost lifts it (+10 dB).

controls.label: Clean Boost
controls.note: S4 'clean-boost' contact (rings (2140,600) / (2225,595)): On puts the 1M + 1n leg across the 3M3 || 12p interstage pad of the clean channel's second stage.

controls.label: Pre-EQ 1
controls.note: S4 'PRE-EQ' switch (pole (1515,340), throws (1420,290) / (1415,385)): 100p or 220p from the top of the clean 1M to its wiper. The 101B manual (2012) gives every channel a 3-position Pre EQ 'B1 / N / B2', N = normal (centre, neither throw) and B2 'even brighter than B1'; so B1 = the smaller cap. Old presets keep their meaning: 0 = 100p, 1 = 220p.

controls.label: Pre-EQ 2
controls.note: Ch2's PRE EQ: S1 'PRE EQ' rings 3 / 4 ((1410,1683) 4n7 strap, (1500,1688) 470p strap) fed from the 'CH2' terminal (1460,1560) when the CH2/CH3 relay's third pole (1582,1309) is on CH2. The cap runs from the 4n7 gain bus (pot top) to the selected wiper (S1 line x 1795 from pole (1811,976) down to (1795,1905)). The panel switch that joins terminal to ring is not drawn; its function and its three positions are the manual's. B1 = 470p, B2 = 4n7 by the clean channel's order (notes S33.2). Default N, the manual's own example ('set Ch.2 Pre EQ to N').

controls.label: Pre-EQ 3
controls.note: Ch3's PRE EQ: S1 rings 1 / 2 ((1217,1690) 4n7, (1312,1688) 470p) from the 'CH3' terminal (1281,1570). Default B1, the manual's example ('Tap in Channel 3, set the Pre EQ to B1 ... kick back and forth between channels 2 & 3').

controls.label: Plexi
controls.note: 101B 'Plexi' mode switch, assigning the Plexi voice to Ch2 or Ch3 (manual: 'the plexi channel can be assigned to either Ch.2 or Ch.3'; 'structure switch and Gain Boost 2 & 3 switch are inactive for Plexi'). Modelled as S1's two changeovers SK1 (pole (1922,982); upper throw (2014,952) -> V2A pad, lower throw (2011,1030) -> the long line) and SK3 (pole = V4A grid ring (2804,1737); upper (2775,1633) <- R18, lower (2721,1737) <- the long line): the lower throws carry the selected wiper straight to V4A through 499k || 470p ((2145-2225,1860-1890)), skipping V2A (where Structure and Boost live) and V3A. Both throws of both changeovers are drawn wired; neither has an actuator on the sheet, so the assignment logic (active when the selected channel is the assigned one) is the manual's (notes S33.3).

controls.label: Stereo
controls.note: Catalogue 'CASSt' (Stereo). The Ecstasy is a mono head; stored for presets only.

controls.label: Sound Style
controls.note: S1a/S1b on the power-amp sheet ('S1 = Sound style'): each pair's screen feed (the midpoint of its two 470 ohm) goes either to 'C' (drawn; the screen supply) or to the dot on that pair's own plate line, i.e. triode connection. S8 crops (1642,333) / (1850,308) and (1625,1142) / (1908,1142).

controls.label: Half Power
controls.note: S3 '1/2 pwr' (legend on the power-amp sheet) driving the K1/K2 relay contacts across the two 250 ohm 50 W cathode resistors. In this netlist the pairs are folded, so 'Half power' brings BOTH cathode resistors in (all four valves cathode-biased) instead of lifting one valve per pair (notes S13.5).

controls.label: Bias
controls.note: The 25k bias-adjust trim under the 51k on bias rail A (S8 bottom left). 0 = 0 ohm (hotter), 1 = 25k (colder). Factory trim, exposed so the bias can be swept.

controls.label: FX Loop
controls.note: The 2-position loop switch of S6: the PI's feed is either the off-sheet 'FROM FX 1' throw (drawn, modelled as the dry path from the channel output) or the loop's return stage (nothing patched). unverified: the dry feed's source is not on S6.

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: Catalogue 'Pwr' (On/Off). Host handles bypass; no power switch on the sheets.
